switch_to_advanced_tip.ht: Show the full Smart Citizen interface with all tabs and options.

generate_apply_tip.ht: Generate the latest enhancements with your current settings and apply them to your game. A backup of the current global.ini is made first.

defaults_hint.ht:
Uses your current settings (the same ones the Advanced view shows).
The first run can take a few minutes while DataForge is extracted.

set_game_folder_body.ht:
Smart Citizen needs to know where Star Citizen is installed before it can apply changes.

Switching to Advanced mode so you can set the game folder on the Config tab.

apply_enhancements_confirm_body.ht:
This will generate the latest enhancements with your current settings and apply them to your game's global.ini. A timestamped backup is made first.

The first run can take a few minutes while DataForge is extracted. Continue?

editor_tooltip.ht: Toggle the side-docked String Editor, a larger canvas for editing the selected row's custom value

tutorial_tooltip.ht: Start the guided tour of Smart Citizen's workflow. Runs automatically on first launch; click here anytime to replay.

restore_backup_tooltip.ht: Restore a previous global.ini from the backups folder. Up to 5 timestamped backups are kept; the oldest is pruned when a new one is created.

test_plan_tooltip.ht: Open the tester Test Plan: a checklist of what changed in this release, with progress tracking and a report you can submit.

switch_to_simple_tooltip.ht: Switch to the simplified one-button view.

reset_window_proportions_tooltip.ht: Restore the window size, panel layout and String Editor column widths to their defaults.

more_tooltip.ht: More actions: restore a backup, clear localization or cache, import or export, open the localization folder

osiris_github_tooltip.ht: Open the Osiris DevWorks GitHub organization

feedback_tooltip.ht: Open the Smart Citizen Discord channel for feedback, bug reports, and voting on upcoming features (requires joining the Osiris DevWorks Discord).

apply_enabled_tooltip.ht: Write the merged table contents to the game's global.ini. A timestamped backup of the current global.ini is created first.

apply_disabled_tooltip.ht: Already applied: nothing has changed since the last Apply to Game.

ship_vehicle_names_only_tooltip.ht: Show only ship and vehicle name rows, hiding everything else including ship descriptions and all other categories. Leaves exactly the rows that favorites and ASOP sort order apply to.

category_tooltip.ht: Filter rows by domain (Ships, Ship Items, Missions, Gear, Commodities, Journal, Other). Categories are derived from the loc-key prefix.

status_tooltip.ht: Filter by status. Modified = you've set a Custom Value; Enhanced = produced by Smart Citizen's enhancements pipeline (ship stats, mission rewards, etc.); Unmodified = default text only; New = key exists only in enhancements/user.ini, not in the base file.

hide_unmodified_tooltip.ht: Show only rows where you've set a Custom Value. Same as the Status filter's Modified option but togglable on its own.

favorites_only_tooltip.ht: Show only rows you've starred as favorites. Favorites get a configurable prefix prepended to their name so they sort to the top of the in-game list.

bp_titles_only_tooltip.ht: Show only mission titles carrying the [BP] / [BP?] blueprint tag.

bp_descs_only_tooltip.ht: Show only mission descriptions containing a POTENTIAL BLUEPRINTS section.

group_sort_tooltip.ht: Sort titles and descriptions together for the same entity

clear_filters_tooltip.ht: Reset every filter (category, status, search, per-column boxes, checkboxes) so the full table is shown.

copy_filtered_tooltip.ht: Copy all visible filtered rows to clipboard (tab-separated)

preview_placeholder.ht: Select a row to preview its rendered text.

editor_underline_tooltip.ht: Underline the selected text (wraps it in <EM3>...</EM3>)

editor_highlight_tooltip.ht: Highlight the selected text with color emphasis (wraps it in <EM4>...</EM4>)

column_filter_tooltip.ht: Filter the {column} column. Filters across columns combine with AND.

editor_placeholder.ht: Select a row in the String Editor table to edit its custom value here.

instructions.ht: Configure your Star Citizen installation path, extract base localization from Data.p4k, and import external INI files to customize your strings.

tools_desc.ht: Import an external INI file to merge custom strings into your user.ini. Keys are validated against base.ini, and conflicts are resolved interactively.

backup_desc.ht: Save all your settings — preferences, tag configurations, your Star Citizen folder, and your custom string overrides for every channel — into one small backup file. Import it on a new PC, after a fresh portable unzip, or to undo a misconfiguration. Backups work across Smart Citizen versions. Game caches are not included; they rebuild from your game files automatically.

export_settings_tooltip.ht: Save your preferences, Star Citizen folder, and custom string overrides to a small backup zip (a few KB). Keep it anywhere — cloud drive, USB stick — and import it later, on any Smart Citizen version, to restore your settings.

import_settings_tooltip.ht: Restore a settings backup zip made by any Smart Citizen version. Your current user.ini files are snapshotted first, your Star Citizen folder is restored (or auto-detected if the backup's path isn't on this PC), and Smart Citizen restarts with the imported settings.

installation_desc.ht: Path to your Star Citizen install root (the directory containing LIVE, PTU, EPTU, HOTFIX, TECH-PREVIEW).

map_language_desc.ht: Set a URL to each language's global.ini. When you switch to that language, Smart Citizen downloads it and uses it as the base strings, instead of the English Data.p4k extraction. The download is cached per language and only re-fetched when it changes. Leave a field blank to use the bundled default (if any).

base_localization_desc.ht: Extract global.ini from your installed Data.p4k to get stock game strings that always match your installed version.

data_desc.ht: Folder for user.ini, source cache, enhancement INIs, and backups. Move this off OneDrive-synced Documents if cache cleanup fails. The DataForge XML cache has its own path below — it’s ~1.4 GB so the default keeps it out of OneDrive automatically.

p4k_desc.ht: Extract global.ini from your installed Data.p4k to get stock game strings that always match your installed version.

p4k_status_found_no_base.ht: Data.p4k found  |  base.ini not yet extracted

migrate_data_body.ht:
Move your existing Smart Citizen data (overrides, backups, cached strings) from

{old_dir}

to the new folder

{new_dir}?

Files already in the new folder are kept. The old folder will be cleaned up after the move.

migrate_data_done_body.ht: Moved {count} file(s) to the new data folder.

channel_not_installed_body.ht: {channel} isn’t installed under the current root. Install it via the RSI Launcher or pick a different channel.

dataforge_cache_changed_body.ht:
Changing the DataForge cache path requires re-extracting from Data.p4k.

What should happen to the previous cache after re-extraction completes?

preview_header.ht:
Apply Preview

Merge Order (top to bottom):

include_new_tooltip.ht: When checked, items discovered from DataForge XML (status 'New') that have non-empty text will be included in the applied global.ini.

import_ini_tooltip.ht: Fold an external .ini into your overrides. A conflict-resolution dialog lets you decide per key: keep current, use imported, append, prepend, or provide a custom value.

reset_user_ini_tooltip.ht: Delete every custom string override for the active channel. A timestamped backup is saved next to the original so you can restore it.

restore_user_ini_tooltip.ht: Restore your custom string overrides from an automatic snapshot. Smart Citizen keeps the last few states of user.ini, so you can roll back a bad edit or recover after the file was emptied.

preview_apply_tooltip.ht: Dry-run summary of what Apply Enhancements would write — per-source key counts (with Enhancements broken down by category) and a Modified / Enhanced / Unmodified / New status tally. Nothing is written to the game until you click Apply Enhancements.

check_updates_tooltip.ht: Check GitHub for a newer Smart Citizen release.

theme_tooltip.ht: Switch the app theme. Takes effect immediately across the main window, toolbar, tabs, and Help panel.

disable_tutorial_tooltip.ht: When checked, the guided tour will not auto-launch on a new version. The Tutorial button in the toolbar still works.

game_path_tooltip.ht: Star Citizen install root — the directory that contains LIVE/, PTU/, EPTU/, HOTFIX/, and/or TECH-PREVIEW/. Auto-detected at install time; edit if your game lives elsewhere. The 'Channel' dropdown below picks which one the app reads and writes.

browse_game_tooltip.ht: Pick the Star Citizen install root in a folder browser.

channel_tooltip.ht: Star Citizen channel to read Data.p4k from and write global.ini to. Channels with no Data.p4k under the install root are disabled. Switching channels immediately reloads strings against the new channel's data.

language_tooltip.ht: Language to apply to the game. Keys missing from the translation fall back to English automatically.

map_language_tooltip.ht: Set a URL to each language's global.ini. When you switch to that language, Smart Citizen downloads it and uses it as the base strings instead of the English Data.p4k extraction.

data_dir_tooltip.ht: Smart Citizen's app data root. Each channel gets its own subfolder inside this directory. Leave blank or click Reset to use Documents\Smart Citizen.

browse_data_tooltip.ht: Pick the Smart Citizen data folder in a folder browser.

reset_data_tooltip.ht: Clear the custom data folder and use Documents\Smart Citizen.

cache_dir_tooltip.ht: Base folder for the extracted DataForge XML tree (~1.4 GB). Each channel nests under this as {base}\{channel}\cache\dataforge\. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Smart Citizen so it stays out of OneDrive. Changing the path triggers a re-extraction.

browse_cache_tooltip.ht: Pick the DataForge cache base folder in a folder browser.

reset_cache_tooltip.ht: Clear the custom cache folder and use the platform default.

extract_tooltip.ht: Unpack stock localization (base.ini) plus the DataForge entity XMLs from your installed Data.p4k. Run after every Star Citizen patch — the strings reload into the table automatically when extraction finishes.

invalid_data_folder_body.ht:
The selected data folder is a file, not a directory:
{path}

onedrive_folder_body.ht:
This folder is inside OneDrive:

{path}

OneDrive can sync and even empty these files, which has caused lost edits. A local folder outside OneDrive is strongly recommended.

Use this OneDrive folder anyway?

channel_not_installed_hint.ht: ⚠ {channel} isn't installed under this root — pick another channel

dupe_check_tooltip.ht: Search this PC for other Star Citizen installs and check that Smart Citizen is pointed at the one the RSI Launcher actually starts.

dupe_scan_failed_body.ht:
Smart Citizen could not finish searching for installs.

{error}

dupe_deep_tooltip.ht: Search every fixed drive for installs saved to a custom folder. Slower than the quick check, and can be cancelled.

dupe_use_tooltip.ht: Point Smart Citizen at this install. Applies from now on write here.

dupe_use_already.ht: Smart Citizen already uses this install.

dupe_use_leftover.ht: This folder holds no Data.p4k, so the game cannot run from it. Pointing Smart Citizen here would make every apply do nothing.

dupe_use_failed_body.ht: {path} could not be found. It may have been on a drive that disconnected. Nothing was changed.

dupe_verdict_none.ht: No Star Citizen install found on this PC. Set the folder by hand with Browse, or try Scan all drives.

dupe_verdict_single.ht: One install found, and Smart Citizen is using it. Nothing to fix.

dupe_verdict_single_elsewhere.ht: Smart Citizen is not pointed at your install. It writes to {configured}, but the install on this PC is at {found}. Applying will not reach your game until you switch.

dupe_verdict_single_leftover.ht: The only install folder found has no game data (Data.p4k is missing), so nothing can be applied here. Set the real install folder by hand with Browse, or try Scan all drives.

dupe_verdict_match.ht: {count} installs found, and Smart Citizen is pointed at the one the RSI Launcher starts: {path}. Nothing to fix.

dupe_verdict_match_leftover.ht: Smart Citizen is pointed at the install the RSI Launcher starts: {path}. But it has no game data (Data.p4k is missing), so nothing can actually be applied there.

dupe_verdict_mismatch.ht: Smart Citizen is applying to the wrong install. The RSI Launcher starts {launcher}, but Smart Citizen writes to {configured}, so your changes will not show up in game. Press Use this install on the launcher's entry below.

dupe_verdict_unconfigured.ht: Smart Citizen isn't pointed at an install yet. The RSI Launcher starts {launcher}. Press Use this install on its entry below.

dupe_verdict_unknown.ht: {count} installs found, and Smart Citizen could not tell which one you play. They are listed newest build first - pick the one you launch.

dupe_summary_leftovers.ht: {count} install folder(s) hold no game data and cannot be played from.

dupe_summary_unused.ht: {count} install(s) are used by neither the RSI Launcher nor Smart Citizen: {paths}. Deleting them would free about {size}.

dupe_summary_quick.ht: This was the quick check of the usual install folders; use Scan all drives to search custom ones.

dupe_summary_cancelled.ht: The drive scan was cancelled, so this list may be short.

dupe_summary_no_launcher_log.ht: The RSI Launcher log could not be read, so which install the launcher starts is a guess based on build dates.

dupe_channel_line_no_data.ht: {channel}: empty, no Data.p4k in this folder

dupe_applied_other.ht: A global.ini is applied here ({languages}), but not one Smart Citizen wrote

desc.ht: Optional features that extend the base localization data: category toggles for the enhancement generator, a favorites prefix for the in-game ship list, and a Tag Builder that customizes the bracketed name tags on components, missiles, and ship weapons.

enhancements_desc.ht: Select which enhancement categories to include. Click Apply to save changes. Enhancements are generated from your installed Data.p4k.

cat_desc_ships.ht: Ship performance, loadout, and crew data

cat_desc_missions.ht: XP rewards and blueprint drops for missions

cat_desc_journal.ht: Mining Compendium with crafting data per mineral

cat_desc_medical_consumables.ht: Plain-language effect summaries for CureLife medical pens

favorites_desc.ht: A configurable prefix is prepended to starred ship names in the generated ship list so they sort to the top of the in-game ship selection.

tag_builder_desc.ht: Customizes the bracketed name tags on components, missiles, and ship weapons. Changes take effect after clicking Save Tag Changes and re-running Generate Enhancements.

blueprints_desc.ht: Mark the blueprints you already own. Owned items get an [Owned] tag wherever they appear in a mission's potential blueprint rewards, so you can tell at a glance what's worth chasing. Select items on the left and use the arrows to move them to your owned list.

blueprints_empty_note.ht: Generate mission enhancements first to populate this list. Blueprints come from mission reward data.

blueprints_filter_note.ht: Type sorts everything into components, FPS weapons, armor, or Other. Class, Size and Grade apply to ship components only.

bp_scan_starting.ht: Scanning Star Citizen logs for received blueprints…

bp_scan_no_path.ht: No Star Citizen install path is configured, so there are no logs to scan. Set your game folder on the Config tab first.

bp_scan_none.ht: No new blueprints found since the last scan.

mission_field_ace_tooltip.ht: Show an "Ace Pilot: Yes" line in the mission details body when the mission spawns an ace pilot. The [ACE] title tag is a separate toggle under General Tags. Takes effect on the next Generate Enhancements.

mission_field_default_tooltip.ht: Show the {label} line in generated mission bodies. Takes effect on the next Generate Enhancements.

stats_prepend_tooltip.ht: Put the generated stats block above the manufacturer/PR description instead of below it (ships, components, weapons). Takes effect on the next Generate Enhancements.

standardize_ship_names_tooltip.ht: Rename exec-hangar (PYX) and Wikelo (WIK) ship variants to include a suffix that distinguishes them from the standard pledge-store version (e.g. "Anvil F8C Lightning PYX"). Takes effect on the next Generate Enhancements.

rs_ore_name_annotations_tooltip.ht: Append each mineable ore's base Resource Signature to its own display name (e.g. "Aluminium (RS 4285)"), so it shows up everywhere the game renders that name -- including the mission tracker. Independent of Resource Signatures under Mission Detail Fields. Takes effect on the next Generate Enhancements.

apply_categories_tooltip.ht: Save category selection. Unchecked categories will be disabled.

generate_enabled_tooltip.ht:
Generate enhanced localization files from your game's Data.p4k.
DataForge data will be extracted automatically if not already cached
(first run takes a few minutes; subsequent runs are fast).

generate_disabled_tooltip.ht: Already up to date — nothing that affects the generated output (categories, mission fields, stats/name options, Tag Builder) has changed since the last run.

favorite_prefix_tooltip.ht: Character prepended to favorited ship names so they sort to the top of the in-game ship list. Click Apply Prefix after changing to update all existing favorites.

rep_xp_label_tooltip.ht: Label for missions without a rank name (e.g. 'Rep: +100 XP')

header_em_tooltip.ht: Style for section headers: Underline (EM3) or Blue text (EM4)

prefix_enabled_tooltip.ht: Save the selected prefix and update all existing favorites to use it

prefix_disabled_tooltip.ht: Already applied — the selected prefix matches your current favorites.

annotate_mission_descs_tooltip.ht: When checked, the configured [CLASS-Sx-grade] tag is added to component names inside the POTENTIAL BLUEPRINTS list of mission descriptions. Uncheck for a cleaner mission body while keeping the tag on the actual component names elsewhere.

reset_tag_tooltip.ht: Restore the default pattern, mapping, and ordering for every category (Components / Missiles / Ship Weapons). Does not save or regenerate until you click Save Tag Changes or Generate Enhancements.

tag_enabled_tooltip.ht: Save the Components / Missiles / Ship Weapons tag configs and re-run the enhancement generator. New tags appear in-game after the next Apply Enhancements.

tag_disabled_tooltip.ht: Already saved — no Tag Builder changes since the last save.

tag_untick_exclude_tooltip.ht: Untick to exclude this element from the tag

tag_mapping_tooltip_ordinance.ht: Edit the Short / Medium / Long text used for each tracking type (e.g. Infrared → I / IR / Infrared).

tag_mapping_tooltip_damage.ht: Edit the Short / Medium / Long text used for each damage type (e.g. Energy → E / EN / Energy).

tag_mapping_tooltip_type.ht: Edit the Short / Medium / Long text used for each component type (e.g. Shield Generator → SH / SHLD / Shield).

tag_mapping_tooltip_label.ht: Edit the Short / Medium / Long text for the crafting label (e.g. Crafting → CF / Craft / Crafting).

tag_mapping_tooltip_collection.ht: Edit the Short / Medium / Long text for the collection label (e.g. Collection → Col / Collect / Collection).

tag_mapping_tooltip_default.ht: Edit the Short / Medium / Long text used for each class (e.g. Military → M / MIL / Military).

mission_detail_fields_note.ht: Unchecked fields are left out of mission descriptions. Applies on the next Generate Enhancements.

rs_ore_name_annotations_cb.ht: Show Resource Signatures (RS) next to ore names

forge_status_not_extracted.ht: DataForge: not yet extracted — click 'Generate Enhancements' to begin

forge_status_outdated.ht: DataForge: cache outdated — click 'Generate Enhancements' to re-extract and update

mt_enable_route_cb.ht: Add route to hauling mission titles

mt_standardize_cb.ht: Standardize hauling mission names (e.g. "Medium Cargo Haul" for every company, instead of "Large Shipment" / "Haul - Small Scale")

mt_route_hint.ht: The game fills in the real pickup and drop-off locations when the mission is accepted.

mt_shorten_titles_cb.ht: Shorten original titles (Shortens stock phrases, e.g. "Local Shipment Route" → "Route")

mt_shorten_sizes_cb.ht: Shorten cargo sizes (Abbreviates cargo sizes, e.g. "Extra Small" → "XS")

mt_general_tags_hint.ht: Show or hide these tags on the mission title only

mt_tag_rep_track_cb.ht: Rep Track Tag (adds "(Security)" / "(Contractor)" to the Rep tag)

mt_scanning_hint.ht: Recco Battaglia's Scanning/Mining missions target specific mineable ores, show each ore's Resource Signature value on the mission title.

tag_preview_no_tag.ht: Preview:  {name}   (no tag — every element is empty or disabled)

scan_logs_tooltip.ht: Scan your Star Citizen log files (Game.log and logbackups) for "Received Blueprint" reward notifications and automatically mark them as owned.

scan_other_channels_tooltip.ht: LIVE and HOTFIX share the same account progression, so a blueprint earned on one shows up in the other's logs too. Also scans whichever of the two isn't your active channel, if it's installed. PTU, EPTU, and TECH-PREVIEW are separate test builds with their own progression and are never scanned.

force_rescan_tooltip.ht: Normally a scan only reads events since your last scan, so it stays fast. Check this if your Owned list looks wrong and you want to re-read every log from scratch instead. Unchecks itself after the next scan.

apply_owned_tag_tooltip.ht: Refresh the [Owned] tag on blueprint names in the strings table to match your current Owned list.

apply_owned_tag_tooltip_disabled.ht: Already up to date — your Owned list hasn't changed since the last apply.

owned_tags_refreshed.ht: [Owned] tags refreshed to match your current Owned list.

export_owned_tooltip.ht: Save your Owned list to a JSON or CSV file, for sharing progress with other tools or another Smart Citizen install.

import_owned_tooltip.ht: Add owned blueprints from a JSON or CSV file (including an scmdb.net export) to your current Owned list. Never removes anything already marked owned.

export_nothing_body.ht: Your Owned list is empty, so there's nothing to export.

import_nothing_matched_body.ht: None of the {count} blueprints in that file are currently tracked by Smart Citizen, so nothing was imported.

owned_added_singular.ht: 1 blueprint added to your Owned list. It'll show an [Owned] tag wherever it appears in a mission's blueprint rewards.

owned_added_plural.ht: {count} blueprints added to your Owned list. They'll show an [Owned] tag wherever they appear in a mission's blueprint rewards.

import_skipped_note.ht: {skipped} others in the file aren't currently tracked by Smart Citizen and were skipped.

min_level_tooltip.ht: Minimum severity to display. Entries below the selected level are hidden (DEBUG < INFO < WARNING < ERROR).

auto_scroll_tooltip.ht: Automatically scroll to the newest log entry as it arrives. Turn off to pin the view while inspecting older lines.

clear_tooltip.ht: Clear the on-screen log buffer. The session log file on disk is unaffected.

export_tooltip.ht: Save the current log buffer to a .log file — useful when filing a bug report.

keep_all_tooltip.ht: Resolve every conflict by keeping your existing value and discarding the imported one.

import_all_tooltip.ht: Resolve every conflict by accepting the imported value and overwriting your existing one.

hint.ht: Edit how each raw value renders at Short / Medium / Long lengths. The element’s style dropdown in the Tag Builder picks which length is used.

reset_tooltip.ht: Restore every cell in this mapping table to the built-in Smart Citizen defaults.

p4k_locked.ht:
Star Citizen appears to be updating right now. Its game files (Data.p4k) are locked by another program, usually the RSI Launcher downloading or verifying an update.

Wait until all updates and verification finish in the RSI Launcher, then try again.

dataforge_timeout.ht:
Converting the game database took longer than 30 minutes and was stopped.

The database found was {dcb} ({size} MB) at:
{path}

A healthy install converts in well under a minute, so this usually means Smart Citizen is reading the wrong Star Citizen folder. An old or leftover install still on your drive will look valid but hold outdated game files.

Open the RSI Launcher and check the install location it shows for Star Citizen. If it is not the path above, correct it in Smart Citizen's Config tab. If it IS the same path, run Verify Files in the launcher to repair the install instead.

cannot_save_edits_body.ht:
Smart Citizen could not write your edits to:

  {path}

{error_type}: {error}

The game file was NOT modified. Common causes:
  • Antivirus / Windows Controlled Folder Access blocking writes under the game folder
  • The user.ini file is open in another program
  • The drive is read-only or out of space

Resolve the underlying issue and Apply again.

post_import_no_install_body.ht: Your imported settings are loaded, but no Star Citizen install is configured yet. Set the installation folder on the Config tab, then use Apply Enhancements to put your customizations into the game.

post_import_apply_title.ht: Almost Done — Apply to Your Game?

post_import_apply_body.ht:
Your settings are imported. The last step is to build your enhancements from this PC's game files and write them into the game.

Backups store your settings, not the generated game text, so this has to be done once on each new PC. It usually takes a few minutes — a little longer the first time, while your game files are unpacked.

You can also do this later with the Apply Enhancements button.
